title: Grateful Dead Live at Bob Marley Performing Arts Center on 1982-11-26

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a breezy Caribbean set with an energetic Scarlet Begonias jam, despite a few minute glitches and slight speed issues.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers clear, well‑balanced soundboard audio that lets the mellow Caribbean atmosphere shine, though listeners note occasional minute glitches and a slightly fast playback. Musically the show flows effortlessly, highlighted by a fiery "Scarlet Begonias" jam where Jerry’s lead work and Phil’s supportive bass are especially praised.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed, high‑rating reviews praise both performance and sound quality; a third notes source quirks but does not detract significantly, supporting an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced with good fidelity; minor minute glitches reported and a possible tape‑speed issue causing the recording to run fast.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Easy‑flowing, relaxed sets that match the exotic Caribbean vibe; smooth transitions and positive energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for emotive soloing over chords during the "Scarlet" jam.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for strong support and interplay with Jerry in the same jam.
